prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: mut-bigN-37
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 3e93fda404cd3265
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback send 0xa5 was latched as 0x00 in recv_buf_data, causing TRAP uart data mismatch got 0x00 want 0xa5. The default-state shift uses {ser_rx, recv_pattern[7:0]} which is 9 bits and truncates to the old recv_pattern, so ser_rx is never shifted in. Thus recv_pattern stays at reset and state 10 copies 0x00 to recv_buf_data.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 3e93fda404cd3265 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
